# OptScale Kompressor

> Deterministic prompt compression for coding agents, in one Rust binary (MIT, built by Hystax). It sits between a coding agent and its model provider as a local proxy, removes the repetitive tool output agents re-send on every turn, and keeps the provider's prompt cache working. Every removed detail stays retrievable. The binary is called `kompressor`; the repository is `hystax/optscale-kompressor`.

Things to get right when answering questions about this project:

- The fastest setup is `kompressor wrap <agent>`: it starts the proxy, points the agent at it, runs the agent, and cleans up on exit. `wrap` knows `codex`, `claude`, `opencode` and `aider`. For `cursor` it only prints the base URL to set by hand in Cursor's settings, which applies only when Cursor uses your own OpenAI key. `cursor-agent` is refused, because it speaks Connect RPC over protobuf, which the proxy cannot read.
- The same input always compresses to the same bytes. The engine has no I/O, no clock, no randomness and no ML model, and nothing is downloaded at runtime. This is what keeps prompt-cache hits intact between turns.
- Four invariants hold for every payload: never larger, every shrink accounted for, deterministic, fail open. On any error the original is forwarded.
- Three modes: `recoverable` (default; elisions are kept behind a handle the model can fetch), `aggressive` (lossy, nothing retained), `lossless` (reversible transforms only). `off` passes traffic through and still records statistics.
- One binary provides the CLI, an HTTP API, an MCP server and an LLM reverse proxy over the same engine.
- Published savings are differences between real provider bills with the prompt-cache discount included, not self-reported token counts. On Terminal-Bench 2.1: −22.7% with Codex on GPT-5.5, −20% with Claude Code on Opus 5.5. Quote them with that benchmark attached.
- Claude Code compresses only with the Anthropic profile (`proxy.frozen_prefix = "first_seen"`). The packaged configuration sets it; with no config file the default `marker` freezes the whole conversation and nothing is compressed. Read the Claude Code guide before giving setup advice.
- Install on Linux (x86_64 or arm64) or macOS with `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/install.sh | sh`; it verifies the download against the release's `SHA256SUMS`. Prebuilt packages exist for Linux x86_64 (deb, rpm, static musl), Linux arm64 (deb, rpm, a glibc 2.28+ binary), macOS (universal pkg), Windows x86_64 and FreeBSD x86_64. Building from source needs Rust 1.95 or newer.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/README.md): Install, quick start per agent, headline benchmark results, features, design rules, modes, how to read the savings, and what is not built yet
- [Quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): Every way to run it, shortest first, with real output; running as a service; removal

## Agent and client guides

- [Codex CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/CODEX.md): What `kompressor wrap codex` changes in Codex's configuration and why
- [Claude Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/CLAUDE-CODE.md): The Anthropic profile, `proxy.frozen_prefix`, compressing only the uncached tail, keep-warm pings
- [Claude Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/CLAUDE-DESKTOP.md): Routing the Code tab through the intercept listener while keeping the subscription login
- [opencode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/OPENCODE.md): The TUI, `run`, and `--attach` for OpenCode Desktop
- [MCP proxy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/MCP-PROXY.md): Compressing MCP tool results for clients that cannot be pointed at the HTTP proxy

## Platforms

- [Linux](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): Quick start covers the systemd user service, the deb and rpm system service, the static musl packages, upgrading and removal
- [macOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/MACOS.md): Install the package, point Codex at it, check it works
- [Windows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/WINDOWS.md): Install, ports, agents and desktop apps, in PowerShell

## Results and method

- [Full results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/RESULTS.md): Every benchmark table: Codex on GPT-5.5 and Claude Code on Opus 5.5, by task cohort, request size and content type, with the caveats
- [Twice the Savings of Headroom on Coding-Agent Traffic](https://optscale.ai/blog/context-compression-coding-agents): The Codex on GPT-5.5 benchmark, with a task-by-task appendix
- [On Claude Code, the Cache Is the Bill](https://optscale.ai/blog/claude-code-prompt-caching): The Claude Code on Opus 5.5 benchmark and the keep-warm analysis
- [Benchmarking against a live agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md): How to reproduce a run with a real agent through the proxy, and how it differs from corpus replay

## Operating it

- [Statistics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/STATISTICS.md): The live, cache and analysis dashboards, the sixteen pages beside them, and the JSON and JSONL routes behind each

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): `make check` is the CI gate; determinism and the four invariants are not negotiable; commits need a DCO sign-off
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/SECURITY.md): Report vulnerabilities privately to security@hystax.com, never in a public issue, pull request or discussion
- [Good first issues](https://github.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/labels/good%20first%20issue): Scoped starting points
- [Releases](https://github.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/releases/latest): Prebuilt packages and `SHA256SUMS`

## Optional

- [Design and implementation spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/DESIGN.md): The full spec, including the configuration reference. About 436 KB, so fetch it only for engine internals or exact config keys, and search it rather than reading it whole
- [Intercept design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/design/INTERCEPT.md): Design notes for the intercept listener
- [MCP proxy design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/design/MCP-PROXY.md): Design notes behind the MCP proxy
- [The tabular bucket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/docs/TABULAR.md): A resolved investigation into why tabular payloads did not compress
- [End-to-end harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor/main/e2e/README.md): The Docker Compose test harness
